data.title: Deutsche Bank Launched Crypto Custody With Bitcoin and Ethereum but Not XRP or Solana. Why Were They Left Out?
data.description: Germany's largest bank just opened its vault to institutional clients, and two of crypto's biggest names never got a key. The real reason may lie in who is on the guest list, and who owns one of the five spots.
